notes: Hand-written seed set (v1, 60 items) for the eval plan's Q-bank. Categories and shares follow docs/04-evaluation-plan.md §1. 'expect' = fact ids a good reply should use (any one counts); 'qualifier' = the correct fact of a confusable pair; 'after' = earlier turns in the same visit (follow-up chains). Grow to 300 per Grandma with Opus generation once the course key is in .env.
